verified_rule: Reference-cohort quantile edges are computed from the fixed prediction distribution; duplicate quantile edges are removed; first/last edges are set to -inf/+inf.
Predictions are assigned with pandas.cut(..., include_lowest=True). Estimator paths explicitly error if any prediction is unassigned.
groupby(..., observed=True) means bins containing no records do not produce estimator rows. Quantile-edge de-duplication can reduce the realized number of bins when predictions have ties.
A bin is eligible only when n_bin >= min_bin_size AND n_observed > 0. Ineligible bins receive NaN calibration quantities.

Each eligible bin receives reference weight n_bin/n_total. For the core ActionAudit scalar summaries, weights over eligible bins are renormalized to sum to one before ICI/calibration-error integration.
Phase 7E separately varied bin count and minimum-bin-size rules; this is empirical robustness evidence rather than part of the original estimator definition.
